Game Overview

In Battleship, the core idea is straightforward: navigate epic naval skirmishes where strategy reigns supreme. Outsmart a cunning AI or duel a friend in thrilling pass-and-play mode. Deploy your fleet strategically, target enemy waters, and sink their vessels before they sink yours. Victory awaits the sharpest commander!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Battleship is easy to pick up. Navigate epic naval skirmishes where strategy reigns supreme. Outsmart a cunning AI or duel a friend in thrilling pass-and-play mode.
